defect.cause: The new negative control used local first,last=assert(source:find(marker,1,true),message). Because find was not the last argument expression, Lua passed only its first return value to assert; 'last' received the message string. The test failed before executing the mutant HUD. This is a test bug, not a new gameplay bug.
defect.reproduction: Exact-head QA run 40528829057: compile_hold success, offline failure; new queued and already-allocated canonical HUD cases both passed, but the whole-HUD negative-control case failed. The invalid index extraction is directly visible in the committed test source.

fix: Bind first,last directly from source:find(marker,1,true), then assert both indices separately. This keeps the full canonical HUD mutation negative control and all existing tests; it does not weaken or remove any assertion.
character_impact: No game source or character changes in this CI repair; C00056 HUD notice fix remains unchanged.

tests.negative_control: Retained full HUD mutation negative control, corrected only Lua find index binding

next_action: Require new exact-head offline and compile_hold success before independent REVIEWER integration. Do not count this test-only repair as a second game source fix.
